Amidst questions raised regarding discrepancies in the voter list of Uttar Pradesh, a new controversy has emerged. While offering an explanation for entries such as "Ram killed Yadav," the Chief Electoral Officer of Uttar Pradesh made a reference to minorities—a remark that immediately drew criticism. As the controversy intensified, the State Election Commission of Uttar Pradesh issued an apology, though it was phrased in complex, formal Hindi. We have simplified their language to make it easier for you to understand.
Video Editor: Satyam
